`rotation-sample.jsonl` is synthetic: twelve readings 2 s apart over 22 s (12:59:48 to 13:00:10 Zagreb on 1 October 2026, so two hours), shaped like the lines of the observer's `rotation.jsonl`.
It pins the counts of `scripts/shown-facts.mjs` (distinct non-transit rows, sentence facts, one page reveal, departures cells) in `test/scripts/shown-facts.test.ts`.
